intent: Switch between related views in place. Line by default, or segmented, in lg, md, and sm. Tabs can carry an icon and a count, and scroll or fold into a More menu when they don't fit.
useWhen: Grouped settings or detail sections on one page
Two to five peer views sharing one context
Compact local switching such as preview and code
Page views joined to PageHeader through its tabs slot (size md, line)
doNotUseWhen: Mutually exclusive form values — use RadioGroup

items.note: icon sits before the label. count renders as a neutral kit Count after the label and is part of the tab's name; never show a count by colour alone.

variant.note: segmented uses the SegmentedControl track: tray fill, 2px inset, thumb radius nested inside the track. Use segmented for values that change data inside one view; line for page or panel views.

overflow.note: scroll: one line that scrolls sideways when the tabs don't fit (touch, trackpad and arrow keys). more: the tabs that fit, then a More menu (kit DropdownMenu, KitLabels moreTabs) with the rest. The selected tab always stays in the row.

activation.note: automatic: arrow keys select the tab they land on. manual: arrow keys move focus, Enter or Space selects. Use manual when a panel is slow to load.

fill.note: The panel takes the height left under the tab list and its child stretches to it, for a full-height tab such as Chat embedded. Tabs needs a height or a flex/grid slot from its host.

requirements: Active tab indicated visually and with aria-selected
Disabled tabs stay visible and are not selectable
A count is read as part of the tab's name
The More menu trigger sits outside the tablist and lists hidden tabs as menu items

doNot: Do not invent TabsList, TabsTrigger, or TabsContent cousins
Do not use Tabs for main app navigation — use AppNav
Do not nest tabs inside tabs
Do not colour a tab or its count to show status; the number says it
Do not use Tabs to change a value inside one view — use SegmentedControl
snippet: <Tabs defaultValue="overview" variant="line" items={[{ id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', content: '…' }, { id: 'docs', label: 'Docs', content: '…' }]} />
